messages:
elaine: quick sync: proposing a short SDK pin to 2.9 for model_group=fastchat-lite. observed tokenization mismatch with SDK 3.x on some edge prompts; want to validate 2.9 for 60m in staging.

deploy-bot: proposed action: pin sdk=2.9 scope=hosted duration=60m requestor=elaine reason='streaming tokenization mismatch observed with SDK 3.x'

runtime: confirm whether runtime needs any routing changes for pinned SDKs?

elaine: no runtime changes expected. this is purely client-side routing to older SDK flow.

ops: ops will approve if auto-unpin is configured and rollback criteria are set. suggest triggers: >0.8% increase in 5xx or p99 latency +20%%.

sre: i'll add alerts and a dashboard panel: errors, p99 token latency, and streaming reorder counts.

docs: drafting a brief note for customers: "Temporary SDK 2.9 routing for fastchat-lite canary. If you use streaming, monitor for missing tokens; upgrade guidance will follow."

elaine: approved by runtime. ops approved for staging only. starting 5% canary in us-west-staging now.

deploy-bot: action: pinned sdk=2.9 for fastchat-lite in us-west-staging at 3345000020 - canary_traffic=5%

sre: 15m snapshot: errors unchanged, p99 up +1.2% (within threshold). streaming reorder count = 0.

elaine: expand to 25% in us-west and 5% in eu-central for 30m.

deploy-bot: action: expanded canary at 3345000180 -> us-west=25% eu-central=5%

ops: one host reported transient CPU spike during expanded canary; autoscale recovered. no user-facing errors.

elaine: canary passed. scheduling global unpin lift tomorrow 03:30-04:30 UTC. tagging @docs to publish changelog when global completes.

deploy-bot: schedule-rollout command ready: `/deploybot schedule-rollout --ts=3345087000 --scope=global --note="sdk2-9-fastchat-lite-global"` (ops final)
